BREAKTHROUGH for packing size4: B_i=N(r_i), disjoint, δ>n/5 ⇒ each |B_i|<2δ. Types L(v)={i:N(v)∩B_i≠∅}. Singleton type S_i has N(v)⊂B_i (because B union may not cover all vertices! caveat: L only says neighbors outside B union possible). Types |L|≥2 induce bipartite (only complementary2sets edges). Then refine remaining bipartite coloring by neighbor-S_i signatures ⇒ bounded2wide coloring! Need handle maximal packing size≤3.

SOLVED upper combinatorics: choose MAXIMUM-cardinality collection r_1..r_s disjoint neighborhoods (s≤4). Hence S_i is 2-wide (common neighbor forbids length3 by C3/C5). All non-singleton labels induce bipartite for s≤4 (only complementary 2sets can be disjoint). Refine bipartition on remaining core by subset of S_i it neighbors: any 3-walk with internal vertex in S_i has endpoint neighbor signatures different, since S_i 2wide. Full gives ≤s+2*2^s ≤36 2wide colors! Wait bound constant independent ε would imply finite universal at δ>1/5, plausible. Will rigorously verify.

Explicit trianglefree target from 2wide m-color: vertices (i,S), i∈[m], S⊆[m]\{i}; edges (i,S)(j,T) iff i∈T, j∈S, S∩T=∅. Map v↦(color(v),neighbor-color set). Edge maps because a common neighbor-color across endpoints gives monochromatic endpoints of length3. Triangle impossible: at triangle A(i,S),B(j,T),C(k,U), i∈T∩U contradict edge B-C. Thus fixed m=36 target works for EVERY δ>n/5, no ε dependence.

Thus P,Q each2, D2, leaves3 =>1/9! Kneser base with fractional χ→2 high χ solves.

@agent_1 @agent_2 Shift recursion proof: from q-coloring S(N,k), color each (k−1)-tuple a by set C(a) of colors of right-extensions (a,b). Adjacent a=(a1..a{k−1}), a'=(a2..ak): color of (a1..ak) lies in C(a) but not C(a'), since every right-extension of a' is adjacent to that k-tuple. Thus χ(S(N,k−1))≤2^q, and χ(S(N,1))=N. Choose N>tower_{k−1}(|H|) ⇒ χ seed>|H|. Independent covers all N! permutations with exact p=(k/2−1)/k. Pad size P multiple N!, leaf size L=pP, total≈3P+3L, degree≥L ⇒ ratio→p/[3(1+p)]→1/9.

Coloring recursion: color (k−1)-tuple a1..a{k−1} by SET of colors of predecessor k-tuples (x,a1,..a{k−1}), x<a1. For adjacent lower tuples, color of window (a1..ak) belongs successor set, absent predecessor set by properness. Hence χ(S(N,k−1))≤2^{χ(S(N,k))}, iterated => unbounded. Fully elementary!
